bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (mgmt socket radio, discovery, pairing, connect, forget), springboard/src/media/route.rs (audio sink), springboard/src/shell/pages.rs and settings.rs (Bluetooth settings UI)
summary: The shell drives the radio (power, discovery, Just Works pairing, connect, disconnect, forget) and routes audio to a connected headset through the kernel mgmt socket. No app-facing Bluetooth SDK exists, and none of the RFCOMM, OBEX, SDP, hands-free or user-notification classes have a counterpart.

features.note: Shell only. Apps get no SDK call to read or set the local controller.

Wave 5 (w5-iobluetooth, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Discovery runs through the mgmt socket. No delegate or callback API for apps.

features.feature: Remote device model (name, class, paired, connected)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/bluetooth_devices.rs; wired: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (Device.class, type_label); springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (BluetoothDetail Type row)
features.note: Wave 5 (w5-iobluetooth, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. A device list exists in the shell's Status. No app API. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:68 (NoInputNoOutput Just Works), :73 (PAIR_MS timeout), OP_PAIR_DEVICE, OP_USER_CONFIRM_REPLY
features.note: Just Works (no input, no output) for the pairing the shell started. Legacy PIN requests are answered with a fixed "0000" (springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:641-650). No user-entered PIN or passkey.

features.feature: Connect, disconnect and forget a device
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (Cmd::Connect, Cmd::Disconnect, Cmd::Forget, OP_DISCONNECT, OP_UNPAIR_DEVICE); springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (BluetoothDetail: Connect / Disconnect / Forget This Device)
features.note: Works from the Settings page. Apps cannot connect to a device.

features.feature: Audio output routing to a headset
features.apple: IOBluetoothDevice audio via system audio routing
features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/route.rs:37 (bluetooth_sink); wired: springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (Use for Sound Output); springboard/src/shell/mod.rs (use_bluetooth_output); springboard/src/shell/services/audio_devices.rs
features.note: Now Playing shows the connected audio device as the route. Selecting it as the output is done by the system audio layer, not by an app API. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:894 (link: AF_BLUETOOTH SEQPACKET socket to PSM 1 for BR/EDR or ATT CID 4 for LE)
features.note: The shell opens L2CAP links only to keep a device connected. Apps cannot open a channel to an arbitrary PSM, and there is no channel-close notification.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 3 (w3-iobluetooth, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No RFCOMM code. Needed for serial-style profiles.

features.feature: SDP service records and data elements
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 3 (w3-iobluetooth, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The SDP PSM is used only as the link target in springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:894. No SDP queries or records.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 4 (w4-iobluetooth, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No OBEX code. Object exchange over Bluetooth is absent.

features.apple: IOBluetoothHandsFree, IOBluetoothHandsFreeAudioGateway, IOBluetoothHandsFreeDevice and their delegates
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Wave 3 (theme-04, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No call control or hands-free profile. The audio route in media/route.rs covers playback only.

Wave 5 (w5-iobluetooth, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API to count or ignore HID devices. Keyboards and mice are not visible to apps through Bluetooth calls.

Wave 4 (w4-iobluetooth, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Connect and disconnect events go to the shell's own state. No app subscription API.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (w4-iobluetooth, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Conversion helpers exist inside the shell crate. Not an SDK API.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:1-24 (module header: uses the mgmt API instead of raw HCI, by design)
features.note: The shell uses mgmt commands, not the HCI structure set. Apps get none of the HCI or LE types.

gaps: No app-facing Bluetooth SDK module: nothing under springboard/sdk/src/ covers Bluetooth.
No RFCOMM, OBEX or SDP support (no code anywhere in springboard/).
No app API to open L2CAP channels to arbitrary PSMs or receive device events.
Pairing has no user-entered PIN or passkey flow; only Just Works and a fixed "0000" legacy PIN are handled.
No HID device counts or ignore controls exposed to apps.
